messages:
nora-cs: FYI — Valerian reported a sudden embeddings latency blip ~2026-03-17 10:30 UTC. Their p99 jumped from ~220ms to ~1.8s, p95 up ~2x. They also saw intermittent 503s with message 'backend queue timeout'. Sample req IDs: req-8a7f, req-8a81. Asking for fast mitigation and root cause.

jasper-oncall: @louise-sre @micah-eng :eyes: can you take a look? Do we have noisy-tenant indicators or scheduling churn around that time?

louise-sre: Looking at infra metrics for the shared-embed-pool. Around 10:28–10:36 UTC I see a few nodes with sustained GPU util hitting 98% and queue length spikes on node embed-ps-12. Also one node restarted briefly (OOM kill in process). Could be a noisy job packing large batched requests.

micah-eng: Can you paste the kube events / pod names? Also need the request traces if available (lk trace IDs).

louise-sre: Pod list and events snippet:

```
NAME                          READY STATUS   RESTARTS   AGE
embed-worker-12               1/1   Running    3          12d
embed-worker-12 log excerpt:
Mar 17 10:29:48 worker embedd[pid]: WARNING: batch_size 512 -> enqueue delay 380ms
Mar 17 10:30:02 kernel: oom_kill: kill process 31415 (embedd) score 987
```

There are a couple of concurrent large batch jobs from tenant_id: t-valerian-01 and tenant_id: t-optera-77 at same time.

engbot: autoscaler: scaled shared-embed-pool down by 1 node at 10:27 UTC (policy: cpu-based cooldown). Suggests we didn't react to GPU queue pressure fast enough.

jasper-oncall: That autoscaler cooldown + OOM explains the p99 spike. Immediate mitigation options:
- carve a small ephemeral reservation for Valerian to avoid shared queue waits
- add Valerian to a temporary allowlist so their requests prefer reserved capacity
- soft-throttle large batched requests from concurrently noisy tenants

micah-eng: Repro steps request from CS -> we should provide a curl to capture timing. Example to reproduce locally:

```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","input":"lorem ipsum repeated...","tenant_id":"t-valerian-01"}' \
  https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -w "\\ntime_total:%{time_total}s\\n"
```

If they see >1s consistently, capture request-id header and send here.

louise-sre: Quick mitigation I applied: created ephemeral reservation and routed 6 concurrent slots to tenant t-valerian-01 for 45m. Command used:

```
rctl reserve --tenant t-valerian-01 --pool shared-embed-pool --slots 6 --ttl 45m --reason "support emergency"
```

I also added t-valerian-01 to the ephemeral allowlist so routing will prefer reserved capacity while TTL active.

nora-cs: Valerian confirmed they see immediate improvement: p99 back to ~280ms and no 503s after your reservation. They asked what happened and whether this will recur.

micah-eng: Root cause hypothesis:
1) a noisy, large-batch job (likely t-optera-77) saturated a node and triggered embedd OOM
2) autoscaler cooldown prevented quick scale-up
3) queueing on remaining nodes increased per-tenant p99

Proposed durable mitigations:
- enforce soft per-tenant batch-size limits in routing layer to avoid single tenant hogging (config flag: max_batch_tokens_per_tenant)
- adjust autoscaler to also consider GPU queue length and per-queue latency signals (not just CPU)
- surface tenant reservation suggestions automatically when queue length threshold crossed
- allowlist automation: a controlled ephemeral allowlist flow for fast response

louise-sre: Filed infra ticket INFRA-7209 to track autoscaler + queue-length metric work. Also opened short-term config change PR to enable token-based soft throttling for embeddings (PR: github.com/redwood/infer/PR/9623).

jasper-oncall: Action items:
- louise-sre: keep the reservation active for another 15m (total 60m) and monitor (done)
- micah-eng: follow up on PR and get a quick patch for soft per-tenant throttling (ETA: EOD)
- nora-cs: send Valerian a mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix, offer migration path to Dedicated if they expect high-burst patterns
- jasper-oncall: link support ticket -> TICKET-4532, include sample traces + req IDs

engbot: note: TICKET-4532 created and linked to thread by nora-cs

nora-cs: Valerian appreciates the quick intervention. We'll update them when INFRA-7209 has a concrete rollout plan. :thumbsup:
